thread:
Maya Singh: Heads-up: Prospect asks for a "low-commit + burst" pilot. Key asks: 300k/mo initial commit, burst to 2.5x, first 60 days overage forgiveness. Thoughts?

Ravi Kumar: Main concern is precedent. If we say yes, need explicit pilot guardrails & signoff.

Tasha Li: Agree. Suggest pilot: single customer, 90-day minimum, telemetry sharing, and non-transferable clause.

Maya Singh: Proposed billing shape: committed line (prorated), burst line at +35% surcharge, waived invoicing for first 60 days but still meter for reporting.

Ravi Kumar: Technical: route burst to a dedicated burst pool with pre-warmed nodes to avoid latency cliffs. Add rollback if sustained >25% unit-cost over forecast for 2 months.

Tasha Li: Product: need token-tagging + CSV export for AMs. Push UI badge to later. Minimal docs + RFC required.

Maya Singh: Legal must add a clause: director approval required to generalize or extend beyond pilot. Also include "no precedent" language.

billing-bot: Action: billing dry-run required before activation. Please attach sample invoice template to RFC.

Ravi Kumar: Ops note: will prepare burst-pool sizing guidance. Estimate small infra work + autoscale caps.

Tasha Li: Timeline ask: can we get an RFC this week? I can draft launch criteria.

Maya Singh: I'll coordinate CS contacts and run first 6 weekly check-ins. Tagging for roadmap as Q2 pilot.

billing-bot: Reminder: create RFC by EOD Thu to be prioritized for next sprint planning.
